item.content:encoded: And just like that, 2026 comes to end. Another year of memories, challenges, late nights, laughter, and moments we’ll carry with us. Make the most of your time at ENSIAS Meet people. Take opportunities. Create memories. Because one day, these moment will only be memories. One day, you’ll look back and realize how fast it all went. See you in the next chapter 💕💕💕 #ensias #ensiasmag
